Herbert Jones scored the Pelicans' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 15 times in 56 starts, or 27% of the games they started. Saddiq Bey was next with 14. The Pelicans made the game's first field goal in 49% of their 82 games and won 25% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
